source.title: AIRWAY BAG INVENTORY
notes: No revision date is printed on the form.
Two-column layout: left column = bag compartments (TOP, LEFT, RIGHT, INNER, MAIN incl. BVM BAG SET UP); right column = AIRWAY ROLL.
NEED columns are blank (to be filled in during inspection).
Table row numbers in source_ref count the yellow title banner as row 1 and the header row (TOP COMPARTMENT / AIRWAY ROLL) as row 2; first item row is row 3.
